name: Shindy Huang
bio: Shindy Huang, S.I.Kom. (born October 15, 1992) is an Indonesian actress, model, and former advertising agent of Chinese descent. Shindy began her career in the entertainment world as an advertising agent and was an extra in the 2019 film Bebas. She rose to prominence after playing the character Aria for two seasons in 2020 and 2022 in the Viu original web series, Pretty Little Liars, adapted from the American television series of the same name.
